text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond dedicates her complete attention to her own running and takes first place in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's finally able to feel satisfied with her performance. She feels lighter than she ever has before in both body and soul.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At long last, she has overcome her jinx. Free from the burden that has plagued her for so long, Satono Diamond sheds tears of relief.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black approaches her after the race. She suggests they both run at the Arima Kinen, and Satono Diamond accepts the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They promise to have an incredible race at the Arima Kinen.
